# clusterRCT - code for analyzing blocked, cluster-randomized trials

# Introduction

`clusterRCT` provides an easy means to run a collection of different
estimators to estimate average treatment effects in blocked, cluster
randomized trials (trials where you have randomization blocks, and
within each block clusters are randomized into treatment and control).
It also provides some methods for exploring data with a blocked,
clustered structure. The package also can be used for simple
cluster-randomized trials with no blocking.

Core methods are
[`compare_methods()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/compare_methods.md)
which compares the estimates from a collection of different estimation
strategies on a given dataset, and
[`describe_clusterRCT()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/describe_clusterRCT.md)
which describes overall characteristics of a given dataset.

The package was designed to support a paper, “An Applied Researcher’s
Guide to Estimating Effects from Multisite Cluster Randomized Trials:
Estimands, Estimators, and Estimates,” accepted to JREE in 2026. For the
replication files of the paper, see [the replication
GitHub](https://github.com/lmiratrix/clusterRCTsim). That set of code
heavily uses this package in the implemented simulations and empirical
data analyses.

# Installation

Installation is simple:

    devtools::install_github("lmiratrix/clusterRCT")

## Replicating the paper

The paper’s results were generated with a slightly older, less
cleaned-up version of the package than what is on the main branch today.
Ongoing cleanup (dependency fixes, bug fixes, documentation) is not
intended to change any reported estimates, but to install the exact
version used to produce the paper’s results, use the tagged release
instead of the latest version:

    devtools::install_github("lmiratrix/clusterRCT",
                ref = "jree-submission-snapshot-2025-11-20")

## Acknowledgements

The research reported here was partially supported by the Institute of
Education Sciences, U.S. Department of Education, through Grant
R305D220046. The opinions expressed are those of the authors and do not
represent views of the Institute or the U.S. Department of Education.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`MLM_estimators()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/MLM_estimators.md)
  : Cluster RCT with multi-level modeling
- [`aggregate_data()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/aggregate_data.md)
  : Aggregate data to the cluster level.
- [`aggregation_estimators()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/aggregation_estimators.md)
  : Estimate ATEs for cluster RCT using data aggregation.
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<clusterRCTstats>`*`)`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/as.data.frame.clusterRCTstats.md)
  : Cast cluster RCT info result to data.frame
- [`compare_methods()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/compare_methods.md)
  : Compare different estimators for a (possibly blocked) cluster
  randomized trial.
- [`count_covariates()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/count_covariates.md)
  : Calculate number of level 1 and level 2 variables
- [`describe_clusterRCT()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/describe_clusterRCT.md)
  : Describe a cluster RCT dataset
- [`design_based_estimators()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/design_based_estimators.md)
  : Estimate ATE via design-based approach
- [`design_based_estimators_individual()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/design_based_estimators_individual.md)
  : Estimate ATE via design-based approach
- [`fakeBrokeCRT`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/fakeBrokeCRT.md)
  : Fake Broken Cluster Randomized Trial data
- [`fakeCRT`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/fakeCRT.md)
  : Fake Cluster Randomized Trial data
- [`fakeCRT2`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/fakeCRT2.md)
  : Fake Cluster Randomized Trial data (set 2)
- [`gee_estimators()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/gee_estimators.md)
  : Estimate ATEs for a cluster RCT using a GEE approach
- [`generate_all_interacted_estimates()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/generate_all_interacted_estimates.md)
  : Average block-level estimates to get overall ATE
- [`get_estimand()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/get_estimand.md)
  : Get the estimand for a given method.
- [`get_structure()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/get_structure.md)
  : Given data, return a data frame with the structure of the data
- [`identify_singleton_blocks()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/identify_singleton_blocks.md)
  : Identify all tx and all co blocks
- [`interacted_linear_model_estimators()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/interacted_linear_model_estimators.md)
  : Estimate ATEs for a cluster RCT using linear model
- [`is.clusterRCTstats()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/is.clusterRCTstats.md)
  : Is object a clusterRCTstats object?
- [`is_nested()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/is_nested.md)
  : Check if one grouping variable nested in another
- [`linear_model_estimators()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/linear_model_estimators.md)
  : Estimate ATEs for a cluster RCT using linear model
- [`make_block_table()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/make_block_table.md)
  : Make table of statistics by block
- [`make_regression_formula()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/make_regression_formula.md)
  : Make a canonical regression formula, possibly with control
  variables.
- [`method_characteristics()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/method_characteristics.md)
  : Get table of characteristics of all the methods implemented in this
  package.
- [`middleton_aronow_estimator()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/middleton_aronow_estimator.md)
  : Estimate ATE via Middleton & Aronow unbiased approach
- [`patch_data_set()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/patch_data_set.md)
  : Fill in missing values and convert data to canonical form
- [`patch_singleton_blocks()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/patch_singleton_blocks.md)
  : Drop or combine all-tx or all-co blocks
- [`print(`*`<clusterRCTstats>`*`)`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/print.clusterRCTstats.md)
  : Pretty print result from describe cluster RCT call
- [`rerandomize()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/rerandomize.md)
  : Return new treatment assignment based on passed one.
- [`run_rerandomize_simulation()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/run_rerandomize_simulation.md)
  : Run a finite sample simulation by permuting treatment assignment
  labels within each block.
- [`summarize_simulation_results()`](https://lmiratrix.github.io/clusterRCT/reference/summarize_simulation_results.md)
  : Summarize set of compare_methods results across estimators
